IDENTITY PARTIALLY CONFIRMED: a 'Shree Shiv Mandir' is listed as an active Hindu temple at Longleng, Nagaland (map place listing; coordinates 26.489268, 94.817921 are single-source, uncorroborated, and flagged as such). A separate listing, 'Shri Shiv Mandir, Hukpang' (Longleng district), may be the same shrine or a nearby one — ambiguity flagged, not merged. Building date, founder, and detailed history unverified. The temple serves Longleng's small Hindu minority in an overwhelmingly Christian district. media is empty: image search found no verifiable photo of this shrine; using an unrelated generic photo would misrepresent it.

name: Shiva Temple
town_description: Longleng is a remote district headquarters town in northern Nagaland, home of the Phom Naga tribe. It sits in steep, forested hills and is one of the least-visited district towns in the state. The population is overwhelmingly Christian, with only a very small Hindu presence.
